title: Honey-Glazed Corn Muffins
summary: Tender, golden corn muffins sweetened with honey and brushed with a warm honey-butter glaze.
equipment: paper muffin cases or butter for greasing

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and line or grease the 12-hole tin.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Whisk the soft butter, sugar and salt in the bowl until pale and creamy, then whisk in the eggs one at a time.

steps.title: Add the liquids
steps.text: Whisk in the honey, then the milk. It may look curdled at this point, which is fine.

steps.title: Add the dry
steps.text: Add the cornmeal, flour and baking powder and whisk only until smooth.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Divide between the holes and bake for 18-20 min, until golden and a cocktail stick in the centre comes out clean.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: While they bake, warm the glaze honey and butter in the small pan until melted. Brush it generously over the muffins the moment they come out of the oven.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Leave in the tin for 10 min so the glaze soaks in, then move to the rack.

tips: The most common mistake is overbaking; honey browns quickly, so start checking at 16 min.
Brush the glaze on while the muffins are hot so it soaks in rather than sitting on top.
Medium cornmeal gives more crunch; fine cornmeal gives a softer crumb.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or freeze unglazed for up to 2 months. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
